projects.title: N8n And Backend LLM DB Maps Agent
projects.description: The project consists of two main components: the Python backend and the n8n workflow editor. The Python backend is responsible for classifying Google Maps reviews with a local LLM (Ollama) and returning a structured output containing sentiment and suggested replies. The n8n workflow editor allows users to create workflows that integrate with the Python backend, enabling businesses to automate tasks such as data analysis and reporting.

projects.title: Azure App Host CI CD Pipeline
projects.description: This project involves hosting a web application using Azure DevOps and implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. The primary language used is CSS, along with HTML and JavaScript. This project is part of a portfolio.

projects.title: Multi Channel Support System
projects.description: A real-time, multi-tenant support-triage platform that ingests support requests from Discord and Gmail, classifies criticality with a local LLM, computes dynamic SLA urgency, escalates critical tickets to a human-in-the-loop Expo mobile dashboard, and sends approved (or AI-auto) replies back through the original channel. The system is grounded in each tenant's own knowledge base and out-of-scope questions defer to a human.
